title: What would happen if Earth's atmosphere became thinner?

lines.text: What would happen to planet Earth if our atmosphere suddenly lost half of its air pressure?
Instantly, sea level air would feel as thin as the death zone summit of Mount Everest.
lines.caps: Sea level air becomes as *thin | as the top of Mount *Everest!

lines.text: Every human on the planet would gasp for oxygen, losing consciousness within two minutes from acute hypoxia.
Water would boil at just one hundred and fifty degrees Fahrenheit, making hot cooking impossible.
lines.caps: Water boils at *150 degrees | evaporating global *reservoirs

lines.text: With less atmospheric shielding, lethal ultraviolet solar radiation and meteors would bombard the ground unchecked.
Sky color would darken from brilliant azure blue to an eerie dark indigo even at midday.
lines.caps: The sky shifts into an *eerie | dark twilight *indigo

lines.text: Our thick blanket of air is the only shield protecting us from the hostile void of space.
lines.caps: Our atmosphere is the *fragile shield | keeping Earth *alive!
